title: Drive to Kyzart & ride to Kilemche
desc: You set off from Bishkek for Kyzart Village, in the hills below Song-Kol. A homemade lunch waits at a family homestay, and your guide runs you through the basics in the saddle before you head out.

The afternoon ride traces the Chaar-Archa River through quiet valleys and open country to Kilemche, a gentle trail and a good way to settle in with your horse. You spend the night at a herder's yurt camp, with time to watch nomad life wind down before dinner.
meals: Lunch at guesthouse, dinner at yurt

title: Over Jalgyz-Karagai Pass to Song-Kol
desc: Today asks more of you. After breakfast you climb toward the Jalgyz-Karagai Pass at 3300 m, a steady effort, but the wide mountain views from the top more than repay it.
You drop down to Song-Kol for lunch at a lakeside yurt, then ride west along the shore, past scattered nomad camps, to the Tuz-Ashuu pasture where you spend the night.

title: Ride to Kyzart, drive to Ysyk-Kol
desc: You retrace the trail over the Tuz-Ashuu Pass at 3300 m, catching a last look at Song-Kol before the descent to Kyzart Village. Lunch and a short rest follow.
In the afternoon you drive to the southern shore of Ysyk-Kol and a guesthouse near Bokonbaev. If you're up for it, there's an optional sunset run out to the Fairy-Tale Canyons before dinner.
meals: Breakfast at yurt, lunch & dinner at guesthouse

title: Ride over Karaly-Archa Pass to Boz-Salkyn
desc: The day starts gently, riding through open fields and grazing meadows toward the Boz-Salkyn Valley, with a riverside picnic around midday.
Then the trail steepens for the climb to the Karaly-Archa Pass at 2800 m, where Ysyk-Kol opens out below. A final descent through forest brings you to a nomad yurt camp for the night.
meals: Breakfast at guesthouse, picnic lunch, dinner at yurt

title: Ride to Bokonbaev & drive to Bishkek
desc: A last morning ride drops downhill through a scenic gorge to Bokonbaev, where you meet local eagle hunters and see this old Kyrgyz tradition up close.
After lunch, the afternoon is spent on the road back to Bishkek, bringing the trip to a close.
meals: Breakfast at yurt, lunch at guesthouse
